evidence.position:
Position: Dev Ops
Job Title: DevOps Engineer
must_have_skills: Diploma/Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
AWS Experience: A minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure deployment and management, with a strong focus on AWS.

IaC Expertise:
  • Deep expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), with mandatory, hands-on experience in Ansible.
  • Strong, practical experience with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
Containerization: Hands-on experience with containerization technologies, particularly Docker.
CI/CD Tools: Proven experience with CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI).
Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for automation.
Database: Experience with the maintenance, deployment, and administration of PostgreSQL and MySQL databases.
nice_to_have_skills: AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer).
Experience with microservices architecture (e.g., Serverless framework, Lambda).
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Zabbix).
evidence.seniority: AWS Experience: A minimum of 3 years
evidence.education_required: Diploma/Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
